soundness_flags.one_line: The class permits finitely many singular S_{xx,n} or zero s_n because its lower bounds are only liminf conditions, yet the definitions use S_{xx,n}^{-1/2} and divide by s_n for every indexed n.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 3, Algorithm 1 discussion; Section 7, especially discussion paragraph beginning "Under PSRR"
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper starts from a randomized allocation, pair-switches until an acceptable allocation, proves unbiasedness and a variance-reduction bound, and states that asymptotic distributions of common statistics remain challenging and are left for future work.
The chain has stationary mass proportional to a negative power of Mahalanobis imbalance, and a distinct rejection/sampling-importance correction produces the uniform acceptable-set law.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv v4 precursor; the cited PNAS page was inaccessible to direct inspection
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Uniform rerandomization yields an ATE limit that is a linear combination of Gaussian and truncated-Gaussian variables, with the residual component unaffected by rerandomization.
The paper uses fixed-dimensional finite-population covariance convergence, nonsingular covariate covariance, and maximal-term regularity for regression adjustment under uniform rerandomization.
Gaussian prepivoting uses a sample-based Gaussian push-forward to obtain weak-null asymptotic validity while retaining sharp-null exactness, including rerandomized examples.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv precursor to Annals of Applied Statistics 7(1), 2013
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Fully interacted OLS cannot harm asymptotic precision and admits asymptotically valid Huber--White intervals under complete randomization.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv precursor to Journal of Econometrics 241(1), 2024
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The fully interacted estimator is asymptotically most efficient and has complete-randomization-style regression-assisted inference for the studied p-value rerandomization schemes.
The article establishes finite-population CLTs applicable to randomization-based causal inference and rerandomization.
A speeded coordinate of a high-dimensional product-target random-walk Metropolis chain converges to a Langevin diffusion.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Restrict the array class to an eventual tail with S_{xx,n} positive definite and s_n>0, or explicitly define and discard finitely many exceptional rows before constructing whitened and standardized scores.

Add a sharp calibration-separation corollary showing a nonzero limiting coverage or critical-value discrepancy between the clipped first-entry law and the classical truncated-Gaussian reference whenever b is nonzero.
After the fixed-k result, establish a controlled extension to slowly growing covariate dimension or shrinking balance thresholds with explicit characteristic-error bounds.

recommended_next_step: Revise the eventual-invertibility and eventual-positive-residual definition domain, then advance this field-tier angle to Stage 0.
